verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents a built-in Video Agent. A user can hand it a goal, review its storyboards, send follow-up messages to iterate, and have it revise only the scenes they name, so the agent carries out the video-creation work. A separate assistant also maps a described task to the API endpoints that automate it. missing for 10: in-app (non-API) documentation of the agent experience, independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence of delegation beyond video generation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Review storyboards, send follow-up messages, and iterate with the Video Agent before generating.
Pick a visual style — cinematic, handmade, retro — and let the Video Agent handle the rest.
Revise only the scenes you name in a Video Agent video
Describe the work and the assistant maps it to the endpoints that automate it
